responsibility: Provides TILE-Gx’s common target hook customizations for GCC’s shared option layer. It establishes the backend’s default target-flag baseline including the configured endianness, installs an optimization-default table that enables both instruction-scheduling passes starting at -O1 to support the architecture’s VLIW-style scheduling and bundling needs, initializes gcc_options to turn on asynchronous unwind tables, and exports the resulting targetm_common instance for the TILE-Gx backend.
